newsitem.title: FINLAND: MERITA SAYS ITS REAL ESTATE UNIT TO SET NEW CINEMA.
newsitem.headline: MERITA SAYS ITS REAL ESTATE UNIT TO SET NEW CINEMA.

text.p: Merita bank group said on Wednesday its Merita Kiinteistot real estate unit would build a new cinema in downtown Helsinki and would then lease it to a new company KinoPalatsi Sandrew-Metronome to be set up.
"The cost estimate of the construction project is about 45 million markka," Merita said in a statement.
The new 1,300-seat multiplex cinema would be located in the Fennia block and would be linked with the existing Formia cinema which would also be renovated, it said.
